elements.definition: The character of the interface between a thyroid nodule and the surrounding gland.

permitted_values.name: smooth
permitted_values.definition: Even and uninterrupted.

permitted_values.name: ill-defined
permitted_values.definition: Merges imperceptibly with the surrounding parenchyma. Not a suspicious feature, and not to be conflated with irregular.

permitted_values.definition: Undulating with rounded protrusions.

permitted_values.name: irregular
permitted_values.definition: Jagged, spiculated or with sharp angles.

permitted_values.name: extra-thyroidal extension
permitted_values.definition: Frank invasion beyond the thyroid capsule. Scored under margin by TI-RADS although it is a claim about invasion rather than about the interface.

elements.name: echogenicity
elements.definition: The reflectivity of the lesion relative to the adjacent parenchyma on ultrasound.

permitted_values.name: anechoic
permitted_values.definition: No internal echoes.

permitted_values.name: very hypoechoic
permitted_values.definition: Markedly less echogenic than adjacent strap muscle.

permitted_values.name: hypoechoic
permitted_values.definition: Less echogenic than the adjacent parenchyma.

permitted_values.name: isoechoic
permitted_values.definition: Equal in echogenicity to the adjacent parenchyma.

permitted_values.name: hyperechoic
permitted_values.definition: More echogenic than the adjacent parenchyma.

elements.name: thyroid composition
elements.definition: The internal make-up of a thyroid nodule, on the ACR TI-RADS axis.

permitted_values.name: cystic or almost completely cystic
permitted_values.definition: Entirely or nearly entirely fluid.

permitted_values.name: spongiform
permitted_values.definition: Aggregated microcystic spaces in more than half the nodule. Benign.

permitted_values.name: mixed cystic and solid
permitted_values.definition: Substantial fluid and solid components.

permitted_values.name: solid or almost completely solid
permitted_values.definition: Entirely or nearly entirely soft tissue.

elements.name: echogenic foci
elements.definition: Bright foci within a nodule on ultrasound. Not a synonym for calcification: a comet-tail artifact is a reverberation artifact in colloid, not calcium, and is a reassuring feature.

permitted_values.name: none
permitted_values.definition: No echogenic foci.

permitted_values.name: large comet-tail artifact
permitted_values.definition: V-shaped reverberation artifact greater than 1 mm in a cystic component. Indicates colloid and is a benign feature.

permitted_values.name: macrocalcifications
permitted_values.definition: Coarse calcification causing acoustic shadowing.

permitted_values.name: peripheral rim calcifications
permitted_values.definition: Calcification complete or incomplete along the margin.

permitted_values.name: punctate echogenic foci
permitted_values.definition: Non-shadowing bright foci, which may have small comet-tail artifacts. Corresponds to what is loosely called microcalcification.

permitted_values.name: increased
permitted_values.definition: Larger or more numerous than on the prior examination.

permitted_values.name: decreased
permitted_values.definition: Smaller or less numerous than on the prior examination.

permitted_values.name: no prior available
permitted_values.definition: No comparable prior examination was available.

measurements.name: long-axis diameter
measurements.definition: The greatest diameter of the lesion on the plane showing its maximal dimension.
measurements.method: Greatest diameter on a single plane, measured on the sequence or window in which the lesion is best seen.

measurements.name: lesion count
measurements.definition: The number of discrete lesions of this class identified.
measurements.method: Count of discrete lesions; 'innumerable' is recorded as unbounded rather than as a number.
